newsitem.title: USA: Procter sues Blue Cross Labs on trademark.
newsitem.headline: Procter sues Blue Cross Labs on trademark.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said on Thursday it filed a trademark-infringement lawsuit against Blue Cross Laboratories seeking to stop it from making and selling its Pref Plus shampoo and conditioner.
The suit claims Pref Plus infringes the trademark and package design of P&G's Pert Plus shampoo and conditioner. The company seeks monetary damages and to have Pref Plus removed from stores.

Blue Cross officials said they were surprised to hear about the lawsuit because Pref Plus has been on the market for at least five years. Beyond that statement, the company had no initial comment on the lawsuit.
Blue Cross is based in Santa Clarita, Calif.
